ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.08:1 white-to-black pixel distribution; the surface is predominantly low-intensity dark pigment with high-intensity white markers comprising less than 10% of the visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity (black) field across both lobes. High-intensity (white) pixel clusters are localized as discrete punctate spots and elongated linear streaks. A higher density of high-contrast white pixels is mapped to the distal ends of both lobes, particularly the right lobe tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped depression with an approximate aperture of 48 degrees; depth extends approximately 12% into the vertical height of the visible fluke structure.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations observed along the entire trailing edge. Notable peaks located at the mid-section of the left lobe and multiple jagged valleys/notches on the outer third of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature characterized by a steep upward sweep from the median notch toward the distal tips, terminating in sharp, tapered endpoints.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-intensity white clusters (3-8 pixel diameter) located at the outer margins of both lobes and a distinct cluster of approximately five rosettes on the proximal region of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of vertical and diagonal high-contrast linear streaks (rake marks) distributed across the ventral surface; highest concentration of unaligned marks is visible on the inner-medial region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive parallel-line scarring (rake marks) across both lobes; significant irregular chipping/loss of material on the outer trailing edge of the right lobe consistent with mechanical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: A series of high-intensity white spots following the immediate perimeter of the right lobe tip, creating a distinct speckled 'fringe' effect.
